steps: Have the seller resolve Activation Lock.

items.abnormalSigns: Owner lock or unexplained repairs.

items.title: Screen and Face ID
items.purpose: Compare the item with the listing before accepting it.
steps: Display plain light and dark images; draw across the screen.

items.expectedObservation: Touch reaches every area; Face ID completes when testable.
items.abnormalSigns: Dead areas, persistent marks or Face ID errors.

items.title: Camera, sound and connection

items.title: Lightning charging and condition

items.expectedObservation: Charging stays connected; condition matches disclosed wear.
items.abnormalSigns: Swelling, exposed internals, repeated restarts or unreliable charging.

items.title: Exact generation
items.purpose: Compare the item with the listing before accepting it.
steps: Compare Settings > General > About model number with A2602.
Confirm storage, Wi-Fi-only configuration and any included accessories.
items.abnormalSigns: Different model or undisclosed accessories missing.
items.limitations: Tap the model entry if a part number is displayed. Colour/storage cannot be inferred from A-number alone.

items.title: Screen and Home-button Touch ID
items.purpose: Compare the item with the listing before accepting it.
steps: Draw slowly across the screen and display solid colours.
Ask permission to test Home-button Touch ID and physical buttons.
items.expectedObservation: No dead areas; buttons and permitted biometric test work.
items.abnormalSigns: Lines, touch gaps, lifting screen or repeated biometric errors.
items.limitations: A brief test does not establish panel originality. Stylus must be compatible with this exact generation.

items.title: Cameras, speakers and Lightning
items.purpose: Compare the item with the listing before accepting it.
steps: Record a short front/rear video and play it.
Connect a known-good Lightning charger; inspect the casing on a flat surface.
items.expectedObservation: Audio/video and charging work; case has no obvious distortion.
items.abnormalSigns: Crackling, charge disconnects or bent/lifting enclosure.
items.limitations: Do not bend the tablet. Battery Health information is not available on every iPad.

items.title: Handover readiness
items.purpose: Compare the item with the listing before accepting it.
steps: Ask the seller to remove their account and complete an agreed erase/setup before payment.
If any previous-owner or remote-management prompt appears, pause the handover.
items.expectedObservation: Setup is usable without another owner or organization.
items.abnormalSigns: Seller cannot release the device.
items.limitations: This is an editorial handover precaution, not proof of ownership or a way to bypass management.

Test touch in supported menus and inspect the screen edges.

items.title: Joy-Con and cartridge

steps: Use system controller stick calibration to observe centring without changing settings.
Test buttons, rail attachment and a known-good game card with permission.
items.abnormalSigns: Drift, disconnects or card-read errors.
items.limitations: Do not recalibrate to conceal a defect. Settings/game deadzones may affect symptoms.

items.title: TV mode, charging and handover
items.purpose: Compare the item with the listing before accepting it.
steps: Test TV output using compatible dock, adapter and HDMI cable; then check handheld charging.
Ask seller to resolve account/parental restrictions before agreed setup.

items.abnormalSigns: No TV output, unstable charge or locked setup.
